data.title: 阿斯特蕾亚 · 居家毛衣沙发上的西瓜满足
data.description: 客厅暖风习习，阿斯特蕾亚穿着蓬松的宽松米色毛衣，坐在沙发前地毯上大口啃着红瓤西瓜，腮帮鼓鼓满是幸福。
data.action: 盘腿坐在柔软地毯上，双手抱着鲜甜西瓜片，鼓着塞满食物的双颊傻笑
data.lighting: 阳台薄纱滤过的柔和散射光，室内气氛暖融融
data.camera: 近景平视，聚焦灵动的可爱吃相与毛绒针织纹理
data.promptProse: 1girl, solo, astraea, angel wings visible behind, blonde hair, messy side ponytail, red eyes, oversized cozy fluffy knit sweater, off-shoulder collar, sitting on carpet by living room sofa, happily eating a slice of fresh red watermelon, puffed cheeks full of food, blissful goofy smile, warm indoor afternoon light, charming and endearing.
